attributes.title: SOC 2 CC5 — Control Activities | Compliance Dashboard
attributes.description: SOC 2 TSC CC5 dashboard header with COSO Principles 10-12 mapping
attributes.visState:
{"title": "SOC 2 CC5 — Control Activities | Compliance Dashboard", "type": "markdown", "aggs": [], "params": {"fontSize": 12, "openLinksInNewTab": true, "markdown": "## SOC 2 — CC5: Control Activities (COSO Principles 10–12)

**Trust Services Criterion:** The entity selects, develops, and deploys control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to acceptable levels.

| Sub-Criterion | COSO Principle | Audit Focus |
|---|---|---|
| **CC5.1** | Principle 10 — Selects & Develops Control Activities | Risk mitigation controls are designed and operating effectively |
| **CC5.2** | Principle 11 — Technology General Controls | IT general controls over infrastructure, security, and operations |
| **CC5.3** | Principle 12 — Deploys Through Policies & Procedures | Policies are documented, communicated, and enforced |

**Data Source:** Wazuh Security Configuration Assessment (SCA) — CIS Benchmark evaluations against monitored endpoints.  
**Default Evidence Period:** Last 90 days (SOC 2 Type 2 examination window)"}}
